name: Clearbit Enrichment API
summary: Enrich company and contact records with firmographic and technographic data.
whatItDoes: Takes a domain or email and returns company size, industry, location, tech stack, and social profiles — used in CRM deduplication and lead scoring to fill missing fields.
privacyNotes: Enrichment data may be stale. Clearbit is now part of HubSpot — verify current API availability and pricing for your plan.
